My Marvel Rivals highlights and multi-kills with Thor from Feb to May 2025.
I love playing Thor in Rivals, he can take a hit but deal damage too 😁💪.
I'm always swinging my hammer - as the saying goes, "Go down swinging" 😄.

The videos are not in chronological order.
